type.title: Type like you talk
type.body: Write “taxi to work” and Zentlet recognizes whether it's an expense or income and which category it belongs to. You just add the amount.

voice.title: Or just say it
voice.body: Tap the microphone and say “spent 35 on lunch yesterday”. The amount, date and category fill in on their own.

month.title: Your month, clear at a glance
month.body: Balance, spending by category and your whole history. It works offline and your data is yours alone.
month.bodyNoCategories: Balance, spending by category and your whole history. Start by creating your categories: food, transport, home…
